scope: Independent audit of authorized controlled r4 adoption and focal C04 to B07 evidence persistence, exclusively local and synthetic

criteria.expected: The former 14-file auditor package and all earlier sealed candidates remain byte exact; this audit uses separate files and resources.
Controlled r4 adoption records the explicit N01/N02 decision and preserves r3 history. It does not adopt N03, modify superior obligations or authorize S11/closure/publication.
The composition reuses invokeC04, EvidencePort and H1013EvidenceAdapter, without a new business contract or a direct write that bypasses B07/F1/F2.
The t1 witness is independently preserved, hash identified and associated with exact restored context and effect/operation/part/attempt identity; no identity is guessed from amounts or dates.

C04 sourceReference, receivedAt, preservation and any verification identity/time have a traceable persisted representation in the allowed B07 schema. No supplied evidence field is silently lost or replaced with a stronger claim.

The registration distinguishes external occurrence t1, receipt, review and current database recording time. It is a new evidence entry about an old fact, never a retrospective work attempt or approval.
Any C04 verified state agrees with the actual persisted review metadata and provenance; B07 read certainty is not reported as proof of external execution or B08 success.
Positive registration and readback execute against PostgreSQL with effective runtime authority, verified local Auth identity, authentic provider MFA and renewed F1/F2 environment generations.
The accepted record is read back independently by its stable evidence ID and typed context; all expected fields, actor, link, operation and history match the input/witness.
Exact replay returns the original record without duplicate B07 record/link/history or provider effect; a changed payload under the same operation identity is rejected as conflict.
Invalid C04 review, untrusted context or malformed required input cannot produce an accepted persistence result; errors are classified and absence of mutation is checked.
Wrong context or unauthorized actor cannot read or link another context's evidence. Known record IDs and witness references do not grant access.
Revoked or invalid sessions cannot register or read evidence; denial has positive liveness controls and is not an HTTP/SQL transport failure counted as security PASS.
The new composition does not expose SQL, signers, credentials, provider tokens or caller-controlled authority; protected fields are obtained from trusted server composition and live F1/F2 checks.
The missing t1 B08 attempt remains absent. There is no claim, start, fabricated attempt, HA reservation creation, result adoption, resume, release or new business effect.

All preexisting B08/HA/financial/business data and immutable history remain identical. Only explicitly expected evidence/link/history/operation and security changes are allowed; arbitrary exclusions are forbidden.
The original uncertain effect remains uncertain and suspended; independent provider contact/effect counts and witness bytes do not increase or change during evidence registration.
All original roles, grantors, memberships, ACL, function definitions and effective authority remain unchanged by the composition; no privilege is added to make persistence succeed.

New test resources derive from a coherent stopped protected copy, use synthetic credentials and identities, deny external communications and preserve original materials. New private material is protected and custodial copies are verified before any deletion.

Expected and code identities are frozen before observed tests; all FAILs and corrections remain preserved with scope and rerun evidence. Independent instruments do not change the executor's candidate.
AC-073 coverage explicitly gains evidence conservation only where demonstrated; missing B08 result and uncertainty stay pending. AC-074 is not enlarged by unrelated evidence tests.

Final report keeps H6-015 IN PROGRESS, ARCH-PENDING-002 and DM-PENDING-005 OPEN, and states exact tested code, resources stopped, custody and reserved decisions. No S11, closure, real resources, commit or publication.
